lines.beaver_en: Hello. The wind is quite cool today.
lines.en: Yes, for September, mornings and evenings are cool.
Right. From early summer it went up to 35 degrees.

lines.beaver_en: It rained a lot too, right?
lines.en: Yes, heavy rain often poured in late summer.

lines.beaver_en: I heard rainfall was higher than last year.
lines.learner: 네, 몇 년 만에 제일 많이 왔대요.
lines.en: Yes, they say it was the most in several years.
lines.roman: ne, myeon nyeon mane jeil mani watdaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: How are the evenings these days?
lines.en: The temperature gap is big, so early evenings are chilly.

lines.beaver_en: It'd be easy to catch a cold.
lines.en: So I always bring a jacket in the evening.

lines.beaver_en: The climate seems to have changed a lot.
lines.learner: 맞아요. 해마다 더 더워지는 것 같아요.
lines.en: Right. It seems to get hotter every year.
lines.roman: majayo. haemada deo deowojineun geot gatayo.

lines.en: Last winter we had a hard time with heavy snow.

lines.beaver_en: Right, it really snowed a lot.
lines.learner: 올해는 겨울치고 따뜻할 거라는 말도 있어요.
lines.en: Some say this year will be warm for winter.
lines.roman: olhaeneun gyeoulchigo ttatteuthal georaneun maldo isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: That's a relief. Still, we should prepare.
lines.learner: 네, 건강 조심하세요. 다음에 또 봬요.
lines.en: Yes, take care of your health. See you next time.
lines.roman: ne, geongang josimhaseyo. daeume tto bwaeyo.
